name: Visa de Migrante (M) -- Inversionista

requirement_groups.name: Direct foreign investment (via Banco de la República channel)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires direct foreign investment exceeding 650 SMLMV (Colombia's legal monthly minimum wage unit -- approximately USD 299,000 at the source's implied conversion rate; the actual legal threshold is denominated in SMLMV and drifts annually), channelled through Colombia's Central Bank (Banco de la República) foreign-investment registration system.
requirements.fix_path: Fund and register the qualifying direct investment.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires real property held exclusively in the applicant's own name, valued above 350 SMLMV (approximately USD 161,000 at the source's implied conversion rate; the actual legal threshold is denominated in SMLMV and drifts annually).
requirements.fix_path: Acquire and document qualifying real property.

evidence_required.document: Banco de la República foreign investment registration (for direct investment group)

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 years, renewable if the investment is maintained

sources.title: Cancillería de Colombia -- Visa M Inversionista: direct foreign investment (650+ SMLMV) and real estate (350+ SMLMV) categories, 3-year duration

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Colombia's initial build. TWO GENUINELY DIFFERENT INVESTMENT GROUNDS confirmed directly at tier-1 and modelled as OR-logic groups within one visa. work_rights set to 'none': the source describes this as an investment-holding status, not an employment-authorising one -- an investor wishing to also work would need a separate work-authorising route. pr_after_months (60) reflects the general 5-year 'investor' track under co_resident_by_accumulated_time (tier-3 sourced there, flagged accordingly rather than restated as certain here).
